title: 1.3.19 Document a Messy Program
description: Twelve lines with no comments, no spacing and terrible names. Fix it to the class style guide and write the README. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Rename everything
steps.instructions: Replace the single-letter names with descriptive camelCase names. The program calculates a book order: use bookTitle, unitPrice, quantity, subtotal and orderTotal, and make the tax rate a constant named TAX_RATE.

steps.title: Fix the formatting
steps.instructions: Style guide: one space around every operator, a semicolon on every statement, and a blank line between logical sections.

steps.title: Comment every non-obvious line
steps.instructions: Add inline // comments explaining what each calculation is for. Explain why, not just what the symbols do.

steps.title: Write the README
steps.instructions: Open README.md and answer the three headings that are already there -- one sentence or one bullet each is enough, as long as it actually says something. Under the last one, mention the tax rate: it is the number most likely to need changing later.

requirements.title: TAX_RATE is an UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constant
requirements.description: The rate that never changes is declared with const in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE

requirements.title: orderTotal uses the tax rate
requirements.description: orderTotal is computed from subtotal and TAX_RATE

requirements.title: No single-letter variables remain
requirements.description: No declaration of a one-letter variable is left in the file

requirements.title: Operators are spaced
requirements.description: No cramped arithmetic like a*b remains: every operator has a space on each side

requirements.title: At least four explanatory comments
requirements.description: Four or more comments explaining the code, written as // or /* */

requirements.title: README answers all three prompts
requirements.description: Each of the three headings has a real answer under it -- a sentence or a bullet, not an empty heading

requirements.title: README mentions the tax rate
requirements.description: README tells the reader about the tax rate they may need to change
